lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-aligned high-luminance spots on the mid-lateral flank, transitioning from high-density small clusters near the branchial region to larger, uniformly spaced spots arranged in approximately 5-6 horizontal rows along the trunk.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal rows of white spots, forming a distinct checkerboard grid pattern across the mid-section posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank; the most prominent ridge exhibits a sharp intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow vector on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density distribution of small circular high-luminance spots concentrated on the basal and medial surface of the first dorsal fin, with decreasing density towards the distal posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density speckled patterning on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the more regular grid arrangement of the main body flank.
